info.name: Vertex AI Image & Video Generation API
info.description:
Postman collection for testing the Vertex AI Image (Imagen 3) and Video (Veo) Generation REST API with GCP Service Account authentication.

### Authentication Instructions
1. Generate a Google OAuth2 Access Token using the GCP CLI:
   ```bash
   gcloud auth print-access-token
   ```
   Or generate an Identity Token:
   ```bash
   gcloud auth print-identity-token
   ```
2. Set the token into the collection variable `bearerToken` or environment variable `bearerToken`.
3. Alternatively, if `API_KEY` is configured on the server, set `apiKey`.

item.name: Image-to-Image Generation (Image Prompted)

item.name: Video Generation (Veo)
item.description: Endpoints for text-to-video generation using Google Vertex AI Veo.

body.raw:
{
  "prompt": "Cinematic aerial drone flight gliding over a tropical emerald coastline with crashing turquoise waves at sunset, 4k resolution",
  "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
  "duration_seconds": 5,
  "fps": 24,
  "wait_for_completion": false
}

request.description: Submits an asynchronous video generation job. Returns 202 Accepted and saves the `operation_id` to collection variables automatically.
Polls the status of the video generation operation. When complete, returns status `COMPLETED` and the video URI or base64 stream.
Submits a video generation job and instructs the server to wait/poll until completion before responding.
